purpose: Runtime defaults for the interactive crop Markov and Monte Carlo page.

ranking_score.formula: clamp(break_even + weighted_score_brl_per_ha / normalization_scale * (weighted_score_brl_per_ha < 0 ? break_even - minimum : maximum - break_even), minimum, maximum)

support.description: Valid NPV samples for this rotation. The support score rises linearly from zero to the maximum at 100 samples and stays capped thereafter.

ranking_score.interpretation: Support has a fixed share of the total score. The remaining weight follows the preference between economics and final soil/water. CVaR5 describes economic downside; support describes the amount of simulated evidence.
ranking_score.total_score_formula: (1 - support_weight) * ((1 - environment_weight) * economic_score10 + environment_weight * environment_score10) + support_weight * support_score10

environment.soil_score_formula: carbon_share_within_soil * carbon_score10 + nitrogen_share_within_soil * nitrogen_score10; nitrogen_score10 uses N_total_stock / (C_stock / reference_CN_stock_ratio)
